crossPageFix.concept: Glancing blows are reduced-damage automatic attacks against higher-level targets; distinct from white hits and generic glance.
crossPageFix.boundaries: Do not replace generic glance/blow or force official spell/item names through the player glossary. Weapon Skill should be resolved via official terminology/canonical mapping rather than speculative stat-specific aliases.
crossPageFix.verification: English-source evidence plus static glossary/locale and cross-corpus tests only; actual French prose, DOM, and Translator API remain browser-only checks.

sourceRisks: Some source guides present differing glancing penalty examples or contain outdated Classic mechanics; these are source/version issues, not reasons to rewrite numeric facts in translation.
